summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, announcing the appointment of Ingrid Zhang as Chief Executive Officer and principal executive officer, effective immediately. Zhang succeeds interim CEO Alan Bash, who resumes his role as President of CARVYKTI. The filing details her employment terms, including a $950,000 annual base salary, a 90% target annual bonus, a $10 million initial RSU award, and a $150,000 signing bonus with clawback provisions. This is a routine executive appointment, not a special situation.
